Maya L: Quick sync — drafting release notes + internal alert for the midnight canary (00:00 PT). Need version pin, rollback gates, and deploybot schedule. Draft below.
Devon K: Ill take the pin. Will set it 45m before.
Ravi S: I'll handle canary metrics/dashboard watch. Propose rollback if latency p50 increases >20% or 5xx rate >1% for 10m.

QA-Bot: Automated check: key prompt-suite pass on staging ✅ (all tests green).
Devon K: Pin command I'll run (ops sheet): `/pin-version inference-api v3.0-rc1 --expires=2026-03-23T07:00Z`

deploybot: [automated] scheduled: `/deploy canary inference-api v3.0-rc1 --region=us-east1 --notify=@RaviS,@Ops-Oncall --at=2026-03-23T00:00:00Z`
Maya L: RN snippet for internal paste: 

```
Release: v3.0-rc1 (canary)
- Feature: adaptive routing by workload type (reduces cross-tenant interference)
- Fix: correct tokenization edge-case in streaming RPCs
- Perf: refined kernel selection for long-context models (p95 latency -8%)
- Ops: added per-pin dashboards + auto-fallback to previous stable on sustained 5xx
Rollout: canary @00:00 PT -> 45m monitor -> gradual ramp if stable
Rollback: rollback immediately if 5xx >1% for 10m or p50 latency +20% sustained
QA: core prompt-suite validated on RC builds
```

Ravi S: Add line: "Fallback target: v2.9.4 (auto)" so on-call knows where traffic goes.
Devon K: Confirmed — will update pin to include fallback. In ops doc: :link:ops/runbooks/release-rc1
Ops-Oncall: Oncall acked. I'll watch error budget and cpu/gpu signals, ready to execute rollback runbook.
Maya L: Final: Ill send the internal heads-up at T-30 and post the RN in the release channel. Devon, please add the pin note and tag the standby list.
Devon K: Will post at 23:30 PT. T-minus 60m check at 23:00 PT for final go/no-go.
